title: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command ('SQL Injection') vulnerability in Metagauss…
description: A SQL Injection vulnerability exists in Metagauss ProfileGrid plugin versions up to 6.0.0.6. This flaw allows an attacker to perform Blind SQL Injection, potentially leading to high confidentiality impact and limited availability impact. The vulnerability requires network access with high attack complexity and no privileges or user interaction.
